belief.title: I Believe
text: Technology is a skill — not a gift. Consistent practice, dedication, and hard work are what turn curiosity into craft. I build that craft one problem, one project, and one deploy at a time.

algorithmsSpotlight.label: Algorithms Solved
algorithmsSpotlight.description: I focus on algorithms because they build strong logical thinking. Technologies evolve, but problem-solving skills remain valuable, making it easier to adapt to any new technology.

professionalStrengths.title: Professional Strengths
items: Solved 250+ algorithm problems on LeetCode — with clear grounding in OOP, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
Comfortable working across the stack — frontend UIs, Node/Express or Django backends, and SQL-backed features.
Able to work under delivery pressure, break work into steps, and meet deadlines without losing code quality.
A collaborative teammate who communicates clearly and learns quickly from feedback and code reviews.
A quick learner with a positive attitude — curious, optimistic, and always improving through practice.
